target: 100% completion on the chosen PS3 HD remaster route, spoiler-free

areas.name: Route and Save Setup
areas.location_cue: The PS3 collection menu, difficulty selector, clear-data prompt, and Bonus Play menu.
areas.note: Chosen route: PS3 HD remaster through original hardware or RPCS3; no secondary content route.

save_backup.title: Create a rotating save set
save_backup.why: No chapter select exists, and fixed urn or gift locations can require another cycle.

levels.1: Confirm the collection version before creating completion data.
levels.2: Play God of War II through God of War Collection or God of War Saga on PS3 or RPCS3.
levels.3: Launch the PS3 remaster, select the second game, and create its save data separately from the first game. The remaster retains the original bonus content, so no PS2 or Vita branch is required.

levels.1: The campaign lacks chapter-select cleanup.
levels.2: Keep several manual saves and preserve one before every major palace transition.
levels.3: Rotate at least four slots and retain a clean file before entering each new large region. Campaign urns can be recovered in Bonus Play, but a backup prevents an entire repeat for missed gifts or chest-ledger work.

levels.1: The first clear opens Bonus Play, challenge mode, and the hardest setting.
levels.2: Finish one campaign and save the clear data.
levels.3: Complete the final encounter, create clear data, and return to the menu. Confirm that Bonus Play, Titan difficulty, Challenge of the Titans, two first-clear costumes, and both movie viewers are available.

levels.1: One costume has a separate hard-preset condition.
levels.2: Finish a complete campaign on God difficulty.
levels.3: Start God difficulty from a fresh or permitted clear-data route, keep the setting unchanged, and finish through the results. Save the clear data and confirm the dedicated costume unlock appears.

levels.1: The hardest unlocked preset supplies the remaining difficulty costumes.
levels.2: Finish a complete campaign on Titan difficulty.
levels.3: After the first clear unlocks Titan, begin that preset and finish the entire campaign without lowering it. Save the result and confirm the three Titan-clear costumes are available.

levels.1: Clear data carries upgrades and enables the urn powers.
levels.2: Start Bonus Play on the same difficulty as the clear file and finish one cycle.
levels.3: Choose Bonus Play from the cleared difficulty, carry forward weapons, powers, health, magic, and collected urns, then activate each urn from the status menu. Finish the cycle so all carried unlocks and missed grey-chest replacements are verified.

levels.1: Rare grey chests can replace missed health and magic pieces later.
levels.2: Record 18 eyes, 18 feathers, six urns, three gifts, and 20 extracted cyclops eyes.
levels.3: Mark each counter only after the status screen changes. Missing eyes and feathers continue spawning in later grey chests and Bonus Play; campaign urns return only at their fixed locations, while two urns come from challenge rankings.

areas.name: Challenge of the Titans
areas.location_cue: The post-clear Treasures menu and seven isolated ranked trial arenas.
areas.note: Complete every trial and raise the overall result through Mortal, Spartan, God, and Titan reward thresholds.

levels.1: The seven ranked trials appear after the first campaign clear.
levels.2: Finish the campaign once and open Challenge of the Titans from Treasures.
levels.3: Save the first clear, return to Treasures, and enter the seven-trial mode. Each challenge can be retried for a better rank; the overall result controls two urns, one costume, and Arena of the Fates.

levels.1: Focus on the required eye-removal finisher before the timer expires.
levels.2: Remove the large enemy's eye within 40 seconds.
levels.3: Damage the required target until its grab prompt appears, perform the full eye-removal sequence, and finish before 40 seconds. For stronger ranking points, freeze and shatter two smaller enemies and keep the protected figure above half health.

levels.1: Launch enemies before finishing them.
levels.2: Earn 200 points from airborne eliminations.
levels.3: Use launchers to lift each target, follow into the air, and deliver the killing hit before landing. Ground eliminations reduce the score, so restart if too many targets die on the floor.

levels.1: Petrify groups and shatter the largest targets first.
levels.2: Earn 35 points through petrify-and-shatter eliminations.
levels.3: Use the petrification power on clustered targets, immediately break the statues, and prioritize larger enemies because they award more points. Continue until the counter reaches 35.

levels.1: The time-control field pauses the protected figure's health loss.
levels.2: Keep the protected figure alive until the challenge ends.
levels.3: Move the time statue into useful range, freeze time whenever the protective ring disappears, and eliminate attackers quickly. Keep the figure above half health for the ranking bonus.

levels.1: Use high-orb attacks and avoid wasting defeated enemies.
levels.2: Collect at least 500 red orbs within 180 seconds.
levels.3: Build long combos and use attacks that force large orb releases, collecting every drop before it fades. Reach 600 orbs for the stronger ranking threshold.

levels.1: Health drains continuously, so offence is the only recovery plan.
levels.2: Eliminate every enemy before the health meter empties.
levels.3: Use the strongest area attacks on each wave, grab weak targets for quick finishes, and spend Rage if survival requires it. Complete without Rage for the ranking bonus.

levels.1: Wake dangerous targets only after the smaller group is controlled.
levels.2: Defeat every enemy without taking a hit.
levels.3: Clear mobile enemies from range, prevent summoners from creating reinforcements, and leave the largest dormant target until last. Any damage fails the trial; avoiding magic improves the ranking.

levels.1: Any complete ranked set begins the urn reward ladder.
levels.2: Finish all seven trials with at least Mortal overall.
levels.3: Complete every challenge, accepting or improving individual scores until the summary reaches Mortal. Return to the bonus menu and confirm the first challenge-only urn is unlocked.

levels.1: Improve the lowest individual trial scores first.
levels.2: Raise the seven-trial summary to Spartan or better.
levels.3: Replay challenges with the weakest ranks, complete their bonus conditions where practical, and continue until the overall summary displays Spartan. Confirm the second challenge-only urn appears.

levels.1: Bonus conditions become important at the upper ranks.
levels.2: Raise the challenge summary to God or better.
levels.3: Replay each low-scoring trial and satisfy its optional objective while reducing time and damage. When the overall result reaches God, return to the costume menu and verify the ranking costume is available.

levels.1: Every trial needs a strong result for the top summary rank.
levels.2: Raise the challenge summary to Titan.
levels.3: Optimize all seven trials until their combined score produces Titan overall. Exit to Treasures and verify Arena of the Fates is now selectable.

levels.3: Damage an eligible cyclops until the grab prompt appears, complete the rotating-stick finisher, and verify an eye is awarded. Use the repeatable first challenge for cleanup after campaign opportunities, then confirm the status counter reaches 20.

items.label: Unlock and Test Arena of the Fates

levels.1: The custom arena is the top challenge-ranking reward.

levels.1: The first challenge rank threshold grants an urn.

levels.1: A stronger overall challenge rank grants the sixth urn.
levels.2: Earn Spartan overall in Challenge of the Titans.
levels.3: Raise the seven-trial summary to Spartan or better, start Bonus Play, and toggle the second challenge urn from the status screen. Confirm its magic-related modifier takes effect.
